## Install

Not published to PyPI. Install from source:

    git clone https://github.com/moneebullah25/python_nbdev_starter
    cd python_nbdev_starter && pip install -e .

## How to use

This lib provides a
[`Card`](https://moneebullah25.github.io/python_nbdev_starter/card.html#card)
class you can use to create, display, and compare playing cards:

``` python
Card(1,3)
```

    3♦️

Suits are numbered according to this list:

``` python
suits
```

    ['♣️', '♦️', '❤️', '♠️']
